name: Mahjong Arcade
author: PointNet Games
description: Classic Mahjong Solitaire tile-matching with a 4-slot staging box, face-down memory tiles, drag-to-peek and guaranteed solvable boards via DFS solver. 37 layouts, 300 progressive levels, classic 4-of-a-kind deck, combo chain scoring, shuffle power-up, star ratings. Mobile-first, no pan/zoom.
instructions: Tap a free tile to send it to the staging box. Two matching tiles in the box disappear. 4 tiles without a match = game over. Face-down tiles reveal their symbol on tap, then go to staging on second tap. Drag tiles to peek underneath.
